prompt: Give me a production-ready docker-compose.yml for self-hosting Infisical with proper encryption and security setup. Include all required environment variables.

assertions.text: Includes ENCRYPTION_KEY as hex 16-byte value, mentions `openssl rand -hex 16`
Includes AUTH_SECRET as base64 32-byte value, mentions `openssl rand -base64 32`
Includes SITE_URL with absolute URL including protocol
Warns about ENCRYPTION_KEY importance — backup it up, cannot recover if lost
